trial_court: XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad (C.C.No.403 of 2018)
case_name: Y. Komaraiah Daya Shanker vs State Of Telangana And Another
facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife alleged husband's cruelty and adultery; police filed charge sheet; petitioner sought to quash proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: If a marriage is null and void, the question of dissolving it does not arise.
legal_principles.held: The Court held that the marriage with the 2nd respondent was in contravention of Section 5(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act and accordingly held that the question of dissolving the marriage does not arise, since marriage itself was void.
cited_cases: P.Sivakumar and others v. State, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A marriage that is null and void cannot be sustained under Section 498-A of IPC.
legal_principles.held: Honourable Supreme Court held that if the marriage was null and void, the conviction under Section 498-A of IPC cannot be sustained.
cited_cases: P.Sivakumar and others v. State, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Marriage declared null and void; conviction under Section 498-A of IPC cannot be sustained.
